gloss: to exchange; to trade (greetings, words, etc.)

definitions.explanation: To give and receive something between two or more people. Used for words, greetings, glances, promises, and other reciprocal actions — not physical objects.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{握手|あくしゅ}を{交|か}わした。
{初|はじ}めて{会|あ}ったとき、{挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: When we first met, we exchanged greetings.

examples.japanese: {二国|にこく}の{代表|だいひょう}が{契約書|けいやくしょ}に{署名|しょめい}を{交|か}わして{合意|ごうい}に{達|たっ}した。
examples.english: Representatives of the two countries exchanged signatures on the contract and reached an agreement.

notes:
## Common Collocations
- {言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす — to exchange words
- {握手|あくしゅ}を{交|か}わす — to shake hands
- {挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わす — to exchange greetings
- {約束|やくそく}を{交|か}わす — to make a promise (with each other)
- {視線|しせん}を{交|か}わす — to exchange glances
- {杯|さかずき}を{交|か}わす — to share drinks (formal/literary)

## Usage
This verb is used for reciprocal, often intangible exchanges between people. For exchanging physical objects, use {交換|こうかん}する instead.
